title: East lane, walkable
caption: The second south-half district from island-half-1 is now a place to walk: the east lane (backdrop since east-lane-1), with the pocket park, the café, the liquor and rice shop, the barber and Amakawa Travel. Reach it from the plaza in the morning: keep walking east along the lane past the cross walk. It also loads with ?place=east_lane. The shops are shut for now.

sections.title: Coming in along the lane
sections.caption: Before: the plaza's camera aimed at the pocket park, which no play camera reached. After: Eric walks on east from the plaza toward the jog, the park ahead. The camera here looks north-east, so the park and the north street's fronts face it.

sections.title: The south walk: café and barber
sections.caption: Before: from the plaza only their backs showed. After: on the south walk the camera turns to look south-east, a little steeper, so the fronts face it and the lane's trees don't hide Eric. Signs (カフェ CAFE, とこや BARBER), the barber's striped pole, and each door shut with a 準備中 CLOSED card.

sections.title: The liquor and rice shop
sections.caption: At the foot of the cross walk: さかや SAKE · RICE on a board standing on its tiled roof, a cedar ball by the door, the door shut.

sections.title: Amakawa Travel
sections.caption: Up the north street past the family flats and the director's house, then west along the back lane to its door: あまかわトラベル AMAKAWA TRAVEL on the canopy, shut.

sections.title: More
sections.caption: The north street, and the south walk after work.
